lines: Stop it, stop it, stop it, stop it, please stop bullying me
Stop it, stop it, it’s pitiful, please notice
But it can’t be helped, it can’t be helped, I’m only weak and have no strengths
She looks lonely, looks sad, so she’s cute and pitiful
Unhappy, unhappy, unhappy, I live by selling misfortune
Despicable, despicable, daughter of the misery house
Unhappy, unhappy, unhappy, the unhappy house is a flower, isn’t it
Lonely, lonely, daughter of the misery house
Stop it, stop it, stop it, stop it, please stop bullying me
Buds are sprouting, buds are sprouting, the sad flower’s buds
Yes, it can’t be helped, it can’t be helped, because it feels good, it can’t be helped
She looks suffering, about to vanish, so she’s cute and pitiful
Unhappy, unhappy, unhappy, I live by selling misfortune
Sad, sad, daughter of the misery house
Unhappy, unhappy, unhappy, the unhappy house is a flower, isn’t it
Painful, painful, daughter of the misery house
Unhappy, unhappy, unhappy, the flower of misfortune will bloom, won’t it
Lonely, lonely, daughter of the misery house
Unhappy, unhappy, unhappy, let’s make the flower of misfortune bloom
Despicable, despicable, daughter of the misery house
